identity: render-bundle prefix with SHA-256 of the normalized immutable manifest including baseline and exact artifact references
transaction: artifact blobs, evidence manifest and baseline association share one SQLite commit
baseline_policy: registration does not update the current baseline pointer; callers select an exact baseline and bundle
required_checks: captured source/PDF/PNG bytes match their recorded hashes
physical PDF page count matches the contiguous page index
Supported static 8-bit non-interlaced PNG structure, checksums, bounded compressed stream and scanlines are valid
historical process-verified render record contains source, profile and process provenance
reviewed mapping input requires complete independent review metadata and reviewed source objects
mapping is rebuilt from captured independent annotations using the current reader and mapping method
mapping source, PDF, renderer profile and page range agree
query validates retained artifacts even if original paths no longer exist
read_semantics: No automatic latest-bundle selection or cross-baseline reuse.
Page query returns mapped source observations; PNG pixels are not claimed read.
Receipt dependencies and continuation cursors bind the exact bundle and mapping.
Older bundles and saved responses remain retained after registering another bundle.
Source, reader, mapping or bundle method changes invalidate relevant applicability.
Catalog and bundle listing do not create content-read receipts.
A different current baseline makes an old bundle inapplicable even when source bytes are identical; historical bundle access remains available.
limits: Registration does not run Word/WPS or re-attest a historical renderer process.
Hashes identify captured bytes; they do not prove PNG raster provenance or visual correctness.
Reviewer labels preserve operator-supplied provenance without authenticating a person.
The internal binary accessor provides retained bytes, not a user-authorized export operation.
The desktop UI, MCP authentication and full S1 independent acceptance remain separate work.
PNG permits grayscale/RGB/grayscale-alpha/RGBA at 8 bits without interlacing or animation; encoded limit 64 MiB and decoded limit 256 MiB.
